about_the_game:
Master the Highways: Multiplayer Mayhem

In LANESPLIT'S multiplayer game mode, your goal is to rack up as many points as possible. Points are earned based on your speed and how skillfully you navigate traffic. The faster you ride, the higher your score multiplier, with the biggest rewards coming from close, skillful lane splitting. Crashes or driving too slowly will reset your current points to zero with your highest points being saved to the global leaderboards.

Endless Thrills

Choose from a variety of high-performance motorcycles, each with unique stats tailored for different playstyles—whether you prefer raw speed, agile handling, or a balance of both.

Realistic Handling, Exhilarating Speed

Experience ultra-realistic motorcycle physics with precision handling and smooth controls. Whether weaving through traffic or gunning for the fastest time, the challenge is yours to master.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen R5 3600 processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: Master the highways, weave through traffic, and customize your bike for the ultimate thrill. Ride with friends, take on rivals, and climb the leaderboard—who will dominate the roads?
